About Christ Sword

Christ Sword is a Christian watchdog ministry standing for truth, praying for the persecuted, and contending for the faith once delivered to the saints.

Our name comes from Scripture: the Word of God is "sharper than any double-edged sword" (Hebrews 4:12), and we are called to "contend for the faith" (Jude 1:3).

"Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power. Put on the full armor of God." — Ephesians 6:10–11

© 2026 Christ Sword. "For the word of God is alive and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword." — Hebrews 4:12
